response.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        m.MediaTypeId,
        m.Name,
        COUNT(t.TrackId) as track_count,
        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as byte_rate
    FROM MediaType m
    INNER JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as overall_rate
    FROM media_type_stats
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT 
        mts.byte_rate,
        mts.track_count,
        mts.byte_rate - oa.overall_rate as excess
    FROM media_type_stats mts
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE mts.byte_rate > oa.overall_rate
)
SELECT 
    AVG(byte_rate) as avg_rate,
    AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count,
    AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: Track count includes only tracks with non-NULL Bytes (those used in byte rate calculation), not all tracks in each media type

alternatives.interpretation: Count all tracks in each media type, regardless of whether size information is present

        AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as byte_rate
    FROM MediaType m
    INNER JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as overall_rate
    FROM media_type_stats
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT 
        mts.byte_rate,
        mts.track_count,
        mts.byte_rate - oa.overall_rate as excess
    FROM media_type_stats mts
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE mts.byte_rate > oa.overall_rate
)
SELECT 
    AVG(byte_rate) as avg_rate,
    AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count,
    AVG(excess) as avg_excess
